structure.unit: Provisions Relating to Accident and Sickness Insurance

text.section: Notwithstanding any provision of § 38.2-508.5 or any other section of this title to the contrary, a health carrier shall not rescind coverage under a health benefit plan after an individual is covered under the plan unless the individual or a person seeking coverage on behalf of the individual performs an act, practice, or omission that constitutes fraud, or the individual makes an intentional misrepresentation of material fact, as prohibited by the terms of the plan.
The provisions of this section apply regardless of any applicable contestability period.
This section shall apply to any health carrier providing individual or group health insurance coverage, including any grandfathered plan.
